$schema-note: Every relative path the doc commands default to, in one file. Nothing here is a path a caller types: --path names the product repo, --out names the content repo, and these are the folders and files inside each of them. Change a layout here and the CI/CD scripts that only pass --path and --out follow it without an edit.

product.$note: Relative to --path: the root of the product's checkout.

site.$note: 'repo' is the checkout --out defaults to, looked up next to survey-utils. The rest are relative to --out: the root of that checkout.
site.$docs-note: Where each product's -site preset writes, one folder per product. The names are the site's, not the products': survey-creator is published as DocsEditor.
site.$topics-note: Topics filled from the product sources rather than written by hand. Siblings of the docs folders, not inside them.
